name: pivot_after_having_order_and_limit
query: SELECT year, root(account, 2) AS category, sum(number) AS total WHERE account ~ '^Expenses' GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING sum(number) > 1000 ORDER BY 3 DESC PIVOT BY category, year LIMIT 8
notes: PIVOT BY reshapes the rows LIMIT leaves; it sorts them itself, so ORDER BY only decides which rows remain.
